datasets.name: executive
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id, u.usage_date, u.usage_end_time, u.cloud, u.usage_unit,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'UNATTRIBUTED')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_dbus),2) AS total_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(free_dbus),2) AS free_dbus_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus),2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
 COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS identities_30d,
 COUNT(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS workspaces_30d,
 MAX(usage_date) AS latest_usage_date
 FROM base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)

datasets.name: spikes
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id, u.usage_date, u.usage_end_time, u.cloud, u.usage_unit,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'UNATTRIBUTED')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
 ,
 stats AS (
   SELECT user_identity,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),6) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS last_7d_dbus,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34)
                 AND usage_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),6) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS previous_28d_dbus,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),6) THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS last_7d_paid,
   MAX(usage_date) AS last_metered_day
   FROM base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34)
   GROUP BY user_identity
 )
 SELECT user_identity,
 ROUND(last_7d_dbus,2) AS last_7d_dbus,
 ROUND(previous_28d_dbus,2) AS previous_28d_dbus,
 ROUND(last_7d_paid,2) AS last_7d_billed_dbus,
 CASE WHEN previous_28d_dbus > 0
      THEN ROUND((last_7d_dbus/7D)/(previous_28d_dbus/28D),2)
      ELSE NULL END AS rate_ratio,
 CASE WHEN previous_28d_dbus > 0 AND last_7d_dbus >= 15D
           AND (last_7d_dbus/7D) >= 3D*(previous_28d_dbus/28D) THEN 'REVIEW_INCREASE'
      WHEN previous_28d_dbus = 0 AND last_7d_dbus > 0 THEN 'NEW_IN_WINDOW'
      ELSE 'NO_SIGNAL' END AS review_signal,
 last_metered_day
 FROM stats ORDER BY
 CASE WHEN review_signal = 'REVIEW_INCREASE' THEN 0
      WHEN review_signal = 'NEW_IN_WINDOW' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
 last_7d_dbus DESC LIMIT 500

datasets.name: priority_watchlist
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id, u.usage_date, u.usage_end_time, u.cloud, u.usage_unit,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'UNATTRIBUTED')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
 ,
 recent AS (
  SELECT user_identity,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS dbus_30d,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS billed_dbus_30d,
   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29) THEN usage_date END) AS active_billing_days_30d,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),6) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS dbus_7d,
   SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),7) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS dbus_prior_28d,
   MAX(usage_date) AS last_metered_day
  FROM base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34)
  GROUP BY user_identity
 ), ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY billed_dbus_30d DESC, dbus_30d DESC) AS paid_rank,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dbus_30d DESC, billed_dbus_30d DESC) AS volume_rank
  FROM recent
 ), flagged AS (
  SELECT *,
   CASE WHEN dbus_prior_28d > 0 THEN ROUND((dbus_7d / 7D) / (dbus_prior_28d / 28D),2) END AS rate_ratio,
   CASE
    WHEN billed_dbus_30d > 0 AND paid_rank <= 5 THEN 1
    WHEN dbus_30d > 0 AND volume_rank <= 5 THEN 2
    WHEN dbus_prior_28d > 0 AND dbus_7d >= 15D
         AND (dbus_7d / 7D) >= 3D * (dbus_prior_28d / 28D) THEN 3
    WHEN dbus_prior_28d = 0 AND dbus_7d > 0 THEN 4
    ELSE 5
   END AS priority_order,
   CASE
    WHEN billed_dbus_30d > 0 AND paid_rank <= 5 THEN 'TOP_BILLED_USAGE'
    WHEN dbus_30d > 0 AND volume_rank <= 5 THEN 'TOP_SUSTAINED_USAGE'
    WHEN dbus_prior_28d > 0 AND dbus_7d >= 15D
         AND (dbus_7d / 7D) >= 3D * (dbus_prior_28d / 28D) THEN 'USAGE_SPIKE'
    WHEN dbus_prior_28d = 0 AND dbus_7d > 0 THEN 'NEW_ACTIVITY_IN_WINDOW'
    ELSE 'BASELINE' END AS review_reason
  FROM ranked
 )
 SELECT user_identity,review_reason,priority_order,
  ROUND(dbus_30d,2) AS dbus_30d,
  ROUND(billed_dbus_30d,2) AS billed_dbus_30d,
  active_billing_days_30d,
  ROUND(dbus_7d,2) AS dbus_7d,
  ROUND(dbus_prior_28d,2) AS prior_28d_dbus,
  rate_ratio,last_metered_day
 FROM flagged
 ORDER BY priority_order ASC,
   CASE WHEN priority_order=1 THEN billed_dbus_30d ELSE dbus_30d END DESC,
   dbus_30d DESC
 LIMIT 200

  SUM(CASE WHEN usage_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),7) THEN total_dbus ELSE 0 END) AS prior_28d_dbus,
  MAX(usage_date) AS last_metered_day
 FROM base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),34) GROUP BY user_identity
 )
 SELECT user_identity,
  CASE WHEN prior_28d_dbus > 0 THEN 'USAGE_SPIKE' ELSE 'NEW_ACTIVITY_IN_WINDOW' END AS review_reason,
  ROUND(last_7d_dbus,2) AS last_7d_dbus,
  ROUND(prior_28d_dbus,2) AS prior_28d_dbus,
  CASE WHEN prior_28d_dbus > 0 THEN ROUND((last_7d_dbus/7D)/(prior_28d_dbus/28D),2) END AS rate_ratio,
  last_metered_day
 FROM s
 WHERE (prior_28d_dbus > 0 AND last_7d_dbus >= 15D AND
         (last_7d_dbus/7D) >= 3D*(prior_28d_dbus/28D))
    OR (prior_28d_dbus = 0 AND last_7d_dbus > 0)
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN prior_28d_dbus > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
          last_7d_dbus DESC LIMIT 200

WITH base AS (
 SELECT u.account_id, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        u.record_id, u.usage_date, u.usage_end_time, u.cloud, u.usage_unit,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as, 'UNATTRIBUTED')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface, 'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.sku_name,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) AS total_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name = 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS free_dbus,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name <> 'GENIE_FREE_USAGE'
             THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0D END AS billed_dbus
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'GENIE'
   AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
   AND u.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 89)
)
 ,
 agg AS (
  SELECT user_identity,
   SUM(billed_dbus) AS billed_dbus,
   SUM(total_dbus) AS total_dbus
  FROM base WHERE usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)
  GROUP BY user_identity
 ), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY billed_dbus DESC,total_dbus DESC) AS rnk FROM agg
 )
 SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rnk<=5 THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0 END),2) AS top5_billed_dbus,
  ROUND(SUM(billed_dbus),2) AS all_billed_dbus,
  CASE WHEN SUM(billed_dbus)>0 THEN ROUND(100D * SUM(CASE WHEN rnk<=5 THEN billed_dbus ELSE 0 END) / SUM(billed_dbus),1) END AS top5_paid_share_pct,
  COUNT(*) AS distinct_billing_identities
 FROM ranked

datasets.name: cost_kpi
queryLines:
WITH priced AS (
 SELECT u.account_id,CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id,
        LOWER(COALESCE(u.identity_metadata.run_as,'UNATTRIBUTED')) AS user_identity,
        COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.genie.surface,'UNKNOWN') AS genie_product,
        u.usage_date,u.sku_name,u.usage_quantity,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name='GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN 0D
             WHEN lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)*CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE)
        END AS estimated_cost_usd,
        CASE WHEN u.sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' AND lp.pricing.effective_list.default IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.account_id,u.record_id ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS price_rank
 FROM system.billing.usage u
 LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
   ON u.sku_name=lp.sku_name AND u.cloud=lp.cloud AND u.usage_unit=lp.usage_unit
  AND u.usage_end_time>=lp.price_start_time
  AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time<lp.price_end_time)
 WHERE u.billing_origin_product='GENIE' AND u.usage_unit='DBU'
   AND u.usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),89)
), clean AS (SELECT * FROM priced WHERE price_rank=1)
SELECT
 CASE WHEN SUM(missing_price)>0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(estimated_cost_usd),2) END AS estimated_list_usd_30d,
 SUM(missing_price) AS unpriced_paid_rows_30d,
 COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity) AS identities_30d,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sku_name<>'GENIE_FREE_USAGE' THEN usage_quantity ELSE 0 END),2) AS billed_dbus_30d
 FROM clean WHERE usage_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),29)

## IFBI Genie Usage and Governance
Rolling 30 days. Genie inference metering. SQL warehouse cost is separate.

## Interpretation
Billing identity may differ from the human requester. DBUs are not prompt counts. Billing records may arrive late.

## Genie users and adoption
Current month by user and workspace. 90 day lookback for new and returning activity.

## Free and billable consumption
Paid SKU DBUs indicate consumption, not USD charges. See the priced edition for estimates.

## Forecast caveat
Linear billed-DBU forecast uses calendar days; early-month data, lag and traffic changes can affect accuracy.

## Workspace and product coverage
Observed Databricks account and workspace consumption; deployment coverage must be confirmed separately.

## High consumption and usage changes
Review stable high consumption first, then unusual changes. These are operational signals, not evidence of misuse.

Usage spikes and new activity (independent list)

Large, stable usage is shown even without a spike. Approve findings with the workload owner before drawing conclusions.

No inferred team, assistant prompt counts, generated-query costs, customer data access, or security violations. These require governed additional telemetry.
